mapper.select: SELECT id,tenant_id,order_no,idempotency_key,store_id,quote_id,channel_id,current_status,origin_country,destination_country,declared_weight,declared_length,declared_width,declared_height,declared_volume_weight,chargeable_weight,estimated_fee,currency,version,created_at FROM shipment_order WHERE tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND id=#{orderId}
SELECT id FROM shipment_package WHERE tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND shipment_order_id=#{orderId}
mapper.update: UPDATE shipment_order SET current_status=#{to},version=version+1 WHERE tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND id=#{orderId} AND current_status=#{from} AND version=#{version}
mapper.select: SELECT id FROM warehouse_measurement WHERE tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND shipment_package_id=#{packageId} ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT 1
mapper.update: UPDATE shipment_order SET chargeable_weight=#{weight},current_fee=#{fee},current_status=#{status},version=version+1 WHERE tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND id=#{orderId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO warehouse_outbound_record (tenant_id,shipment_order_id,shipment_package_id,provider_id,tracking_no,outbound_by,outbound_at,handover_remark) SELECT #{tenantId},#{orderId},#{packageId},channel.provider_id,#{tracking},#{userId},#{at},#{remark} FROM logistics_channel channel JOIN shipment_order o ON o.channel_id=channel.id WHERE o.id=#{orderId} AND o.tenant_id=#{tenantId}
